survey: All 359 inputs on 82 routes before (raw/helpers-baseline.json) and after (raw/helpers-after.json): 196 helpers changed; 0 remaining with "unless the label says otherwise", "recurring amount" or "… in years." phrasing.

helpers.Interest rate: Yearly rate as a percentage, for example 7.5 for 7.5% a year.
helpers.Foreclosure payment: Enter the foreclosure payment in the calculator currency.

helpers.Estimated withholding rate: Enter as a percentage, for example 18 for 18%.
helpers.Pay periods per year: Number of pay periods in a year; for example, 26 for biweekly pay.

helpers.GST rate: Enter as a percentage, for example 18 for 18%.
